# OpenView Partners

> > Expansion-stage venture capital insights and portfolio company announcements from OpenView Partners

OpenView Partners is a venture capital firm focused on expansion-stage B2B SaaS companies, with expertise in product-led growth, sales enablement, and workflow automation. The Expand Upon blog features investment announcements, go-to-market strategies, and thought leadership from partners including Scott Maxwell.

## Key Topics

- Product-led growth
- Expansion-stage capital
- B2B SaaS investment
- Sales enablement
- Workflow automation
- No-code platforms
- Business process management
- Go-to-market strategy
- Series A and Series C funding
- Operations excellence
- Self-service GTM
- Sales technology
- Content management
- Marketing collateral

## Main Hub

- [Expand Upon](https://expand.openviewpartners.com/): OpenView's blog hub for expansion stage capital insights and portfolio news
